readings.meaning: speech therapy, pronunciation, or voice coaching

ambiguity: Because the arcs curve toward the person (longer arc inside, shorter outside), it literally depicts waves incoming (listening/hearing), but at small sizes it is almost indistinguishable from the standard person-speaking or voice-over icon where waves radiate outward.

reasoning: The icon shows a person bust with sound waves next to the head, clearly signaling speaking, voice communication, or listening/hearing. It fits tasks centered on in-person conversations, public speaking, pronunciation practice, speech therapy, or audiology. It can be confused with a standard outgoing-voice icon (since the arcs curve inward) or with contactless/radio wave badges.
